title: Four-Cheese White Pizza
shortDescription: Creamy white pie, no red sauce
subtitle: Creamy white pie, no red sauce
description: Creamy white pie, no red sauce. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.

steps.title: Season ricotta and garlic oil
steps.instruction: Stir ricotta with half the garlic, salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil until creamy. Warm remaining garlic gently in olive oil 2 minutes — do not brown or it tastes bitter on a white pie.

steps.title: Preheat stone to 500°F
steps.instruction: Heat stone or steel at 500°F at least 40 minutes. Tear fresh mozzarella and grate hard cheeses while the oven saturates.

steps.title: Stretch and schmear ricotta
steps.instruction: Stretch dough to 12–14 inch rounds. Spread seasoned ricotta in a thin even layer — thick ricotta pockets stay cold in the center. Brush rims with garlic oil.

steps.title: Four-cheese layer
steps.instruction: Add fresh mozzarella, shredded mozzarella, fontina, and parmesan. Four-Cheese White Pizza has no tomato — if you see red sauce, you grabbed the wrong pan.

steps.title: Bake until golden and bubbling
steps.instruction: Bake 11–14 minutes until cheeses melt together with golden spots and the crust underside is crisp. White pies show doneness on cheese color, not pepperoni curl.

steps.title: Thyme, rest, and cut
steps.instruction: Scatter thyme leaves after the bake. Rest 2 minutes, cut 8 slices per pie. Rich pie — one backup tray at 200°F is enough for seconds without turning greasy.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Cut pies into hall slices (8 per pie minimum) and fan on sheet trays.
Keep a fresh pie warming in the oven — pizza dies fast on the counter.
Line up Four-Cheese White Pizza on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Creamy white pie, no red sauce. A hall pick for regular dinner nights — one line, real portions, no drama at the stove.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free pizza crust.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use oat, almond, or soy milk (check tree-nut/soy status of the substitute). Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative.
